# Scales, moods and outside notes

Pitches are MIDI numbers, 60 = middle C. Onsets are slots 0 to 15 of a sixteenth grid, so slot 4 is beat 2; lengths are in beats. Tiers: M1 is needed in a first test set, M2 has one or two sources or is a jazz or world idiom, M3 is single-source, inferred or theory only. Tags: `source states`, `measured`, `derived` (our computation on public data), `inferred` (our reading), `snippet` (a search excerpt), `single source`, `proposal` (a policy, not a fact). Source ids are listed in `dictionary/sources.json`.

## Mood words

| bright (happy) | `mood.bright` | none | A bright or happy request. Listeners rated Lydian less happy than major, so Lydian suits airy better than happy. | `scale.major`; also `scale.lydian`. Take major; take Lydian for airy or floating. | M1 | proposal | guides, lexicon, temperley-tan, eerola |
| sad (melancholic) | `mood.sad` | none | A sad or melancholic request. Dorian reads as a less sad minor. | `scale.natural-minor`; also `scale.dorian`. Take natural minor; take Dorian for a less sad colour. | M1 | proposal | guides, lexicon, eerola |
| uplifting | `mood.uplifting` | none | An uplifting request, where sources conflict. | dreamy | `mood.dreamy` | none | A dreamy request. A major-leaning sound takes Lydian, and a minor-leaning one takes Dorian with ninth chords. | `scale.lydian`; also `scale.dorian`. Take Phrygian dominant; take double harmonic major for very arabic or byzantine. | M1 | proposal | guides, lexicon |
| epic (heroic) | `mood.epic` | none | An epic or heroic request, where sources agree little. The pick is a natural minor loop in a wide register. | `scale.natural-minor`; also `scale.lydian`, `scale.harmonic-minor`. Take natural minor with an i-bVI-bVII loop and a wide register. | M2 | proposal | guides, lexicon |
| cinematic, sense `drama`, default | `mood.cinematic.drama` | none | A cinematic request that means drama: natural minor. This is the batch default. | `scale.natural-minor`; also `scale.lydian`.
